messages.subject: Project Larkspur - VAT option to tax (action needed before completion)
messages.plaintextBody:
Rebecca,

For the TOGC treatment to hold, Marchwood must (i) opt to tax Kestrel House and (ii) notify HMRC of the option before completion (8 May). I'll prepare the VAT1614A; please have a director ready to sign this week. If the option/notification isn't in place, VAT of £2.85m would be chargeable on completion, so this is important.

Elena
